findings.title: Binary logging is off
findings.detail: log_bin is OFF, so replication cannot be set up and point in time recovery between backups is impossible.
findings.recommendation: Enable log_bin with binlog_format ROW, set an expiry (binlog_expire_logs_seconds or expire_logs_days) and sync_binlog 1; restart required.

findings.title: Single server with no replica
findings.detail: SHOW REPLICA STATUS is empty and no replica is connected, so a host failure means downtime until a restore completes.
findings.recommendation: Add a replica (asynchronous or semi synchronous) and a documented promotion procedure; agree the recovery time objective with the business first.

findings.title: No schema migration history table found
findings.detail: No migration tool history table exists, so schema changes are probably applied by hand.
findings.recommendation: Adopt one migration tool and put every DDL change in version control with a review step; baseline the current schema first.

findings.title: TLS is not available on the server
findings.detail: have_ssl is DISABLED, so every network client sends credentials and data in clear text.
findings.recommendation: Install a certificate (ssl_ca, ssl_cert, ssl_key), restart, then set require_secure_transport ON once clients are verified.

findings.title: local_infile is enabled
findings.detail: A compromised or malicious server can read files from a connecting client's file system through LOAD DATA LOCAL.
findings.recommendation: Set local_infile OFF unless a specific loader needs it, and then limit it to that user.

findings.title: Host name resolution is on for connections
findings.detail: skip_name_resolve is OFF; DNS delays slow connections and grants keyed on host names depend on DNS being trustworthy.
findings.recommendation: Turn skip_name_resolve ON and convert host based grants to IP ranges.

findings.title: Accounts accept connections from any host
findings.recommendation: Limit each account's host to the application subnet; the firewall should not be the only control.

findings.title: Passwords never expire by default
findings.recommendation: Set a lifetime for human accounts and exempt service accounts explicitly (ALTER USER ... PASSWORD EXPIRE NEVER).

findings.title: Slow query log is off
findings.detail: No record of slow statements exists, so performance work has no evidence to start from.
findings.recommendation: Set slow_query_log ON with long_query_time around 1 second and review with `pt-query-digest` or the Performance Schema.

findings.title: Performance Schema is off
findings.detail: Per statement and wait event instrumentation is unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Enable performance_schema (restart) with the default instruments.

findings.title: 1 MyISAM table(s) in application schemas
findings.detail: MyISAM has no crash recovery, no transactions and table level locks: shopdemo.legacy_log.
findings.recommendation: Convert to InnoDB (ALTER TABLE ... ENGINE=InnoDB) after checking for FULLTEXT or spatial features that need attention.

unknowns.question: Backup schedule, retention and the date of the last successful restore test
unknowns.how_to_obtain: Ask the operations owner for the backup job (mysqldump, mariabackup, xtrabackup or snapshots), retention and restore test log; the server cannot report these
